city.description: City where the customer is located.

customer_segment.description: Customer segment such as regular, premium, or business.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the customer record was created.

products.description: Stores products available in the store.

category.description: Product category such as Electronics, Clothing, Home, Books, or Sports.

unit_price.description: Current unit price of the product.

order_date.description: Date when the order was placed.

status.description: Order status such as completed, shipped, or cancelled.

total_amount.description: Total monetary value of the complete order.

order_items.description: Stores individual products contained in each order.

order_item_id.description: Unique identifier for an order item.

product_id.description: Product associated with this order item.

unit_price.description: Price per unit when the order was placed.

payments.description: Stores payment records associated with orders.

payment_date.description: Date when the payment was recorded.

payment_method.description: Payment method such as UPI, Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking.

business_rules: Cancelled orders should normally be excluded when calculating sales, revenue, or customer spending unless the user explicitly asks to include cancelled orders.
orders.total_amount represents the total monetary value of an order.
For product-level or category-level revenue calculations, use order_items.quantity multiplied by order_items.unit_price.
Use order_items.unit_price for historical product sales calculations rather than products.unit_price because the order item stores the price at the time of purchase.
Customer spending can be calculated from orders.total_amount after excluding cancelled orders.
payments should be used when the question specifically concerns payment methods, payment amounts, or payment status.
